insight: Reached general availability at Microsoft Build 2026; was used to help develop Microsoft's Majorana 2 topological quantum chip.
name: Microsoft Discovery
tagline: An agentic platform for enterprise scientific R&D on Azure.
description: An enterprise platform that lets research teams deploy specialized AI agents over a graph-based knowledge engine to run the full R&D loop — exploring literature, generating hypotheses, optimizing experiments, and validating results. It spans chemistry, materials science, biology, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors, and runs on Azure HPC and AI Foundry infrastructure with enterprise governance. Researchers can integrate their own models, tools, and datasets.

modelSupport.notes: Integrates Azure AI Foundry models plus customers' own models.

edge: Couples specialized R&D agents with a graph knowledge engine and Azure HPC across chemistry, materials, and biology — one governed stack, not a point tool.
pros: Runs the full R&D loop end to end
Bring your own models and datasets

references.title: Microsoft Discovery GA on Azure, Powering the AI behind Majorana 2
